On the layout, both are clear and either works for me. I slightly prefer Version A — editing right there inside the card keeps me in context, so I can see the bookmark as I change it. Version B's focused panel is fine too.

On the scope, though — since you asked — that's a bit narrower than I'd want. Fixing the title and tags is the main thing, so that's good. But I'd also want to be able to edit the description, since that's the summary that helps me recognise and search for a bookmark later, and the auto-filled one isn't always right. Being able to correct the web address too would round it out, in case I saved the wrong link. So please open editing up to at least the description as well, not just title and tags.
